trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
1. Finish the story first. Chapters 1 to 4 and the finale run about 35 hours, and every cleanup trophy is easier with the whole map, the Rhino and both protagonists unlocked.
2. Before Chapter 3, clear the nine missables. Cal, Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, the Headliners balcony and the Grassrivers light all close behind you; the missables view lists every lock point.
3. Sweep the state in this order: hobbies (shooting range, Top Fun, races, bowling, arcade), collectibles (cards, WAiNK, meditations), crimes (vaults, gangs, shops), then the 250 stunts and the 100% checklist.
4. Keep $250,000 of marked bills for Dime on the Dollar and $100,000 of shopping money for Treat Yo Self. The five vaults and nine gang operations cover both.
5. The platinum lands with the 55th trophy, almost always A Long Road at 100%. Nothing in the list is difficulty gated and nothing needs another player.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.hint: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
trophies.guide:
1. Gone Fishing opens on the dock at Cal Hampton's marina on Key Lento, right after Lucia's release scene at the penitentiary.
2. Follow Cal onto the Skiff and take the wheel when he offers it. The mission is the casting tutorial: keep the line tight and reel only when the rod tip pulls, not when the float bobs.
3. Land the three keeper snapper at the buoy line, then run the boat under the Overseas Highway bridge when the radio call comes in.
4. The trophy pops on the dock the moment the mission ends. If the tutorial cast fails, replay it from Pause > Game > Replay Mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
1. Chapter 1 is Jason's half of the Keys: Cal's marina, Brian Heder's gun runs out of the Port Gellhorn boatyard, and Lucia's parole meetings across the water in Vice Beach.
2. Run Breakfast Run before the chapter's last job. It is the only clean way to bank Trust, and the van route is far easier in daylight.
3. Clear Cal's fishing challenge before you leave the Keys; Baited My Tackle locks the moment Chapter 2 opens.
4. The chapter ends with the marina handoff. The trophy arrives with the chapter card, about nine hours in if you are doing the side content as you go.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
1. Chapter 2 moves the pair inland to Ambrosia: Boobie Ike's crew, the Real Dimez shows, and Dre'Quan Priest's supply line running down from Vice City.
2. Do The Cartel Heist and Child's Play early. They unlock the garage properties and the red gang operation markers you will want for Pest Control.
3. Start WAiNK and the collectible card sets here. The Ambrosia truck stop and the fairground are two of the densest card and WAiNK spots in Leonida.
4. Buy the Ambrosia and Port Gellhorn garages before the chapter closes; prices climb after Chapter 3 and Little Boxes wants all eight.
5. The chapter card lands after the silo job, around 20 hours in.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
1. Chapter 3 is the Vice City act: Headliners at the Vice Beach arena, the VCIA Takedown, and Raul Bautista's vault crew.
2. Take the balcony photo for Personal Best on the night of Headliners. The prompt dies with the chapter and replay does not re-arm it.
3. Start the bank vaults as soon as Raul introduces the crew. Five vaults is a silver, and the marked bills fund the garages and Dime on the Dollar.
4. VCIA Takedown puts the airport into lockdown for the rest of the chapter, so finish Kenton's boat strand before you take the job.
5. The chapter ends on the Downtown rooftop, around 33 hours in.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
1. Chapter 4 takes Jason and Lucia into the Grassrivers and up Mount Kalaga, with Operation Savage Glory as the centrepiece.
2. Steal the Rhino during Savage Glory while the depot is already alerted. Challenging Tank is far harder to set up after the chapter.
3. Finish Bret's strand and the 18 meditations before the chapter card; Bret's camp closes when Chapter 4 ends.
4. The Grassrivers light for The Truth Is Out There only spawns on a clear night in this chapter. See the missables view.
5. The trophy lands with the chapter card, around 45 hours in.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide:
1. The final mission starts at the safehouse after the Chapter 4 card. Bring the Carbine Rifle, full armour and a fast car parked outside.
2. Phase one is the tower lobby. Clear it quietly with the silenced pistol; the alarm adds two minutes of reinforcements before you reach the lift.
3. Phase two is the roof. Burn Combat Focus on the helicopter crews and keep moving between the AC units instead of holding one crate.
4. Phase three is the boat run through the Port of Vice City. Stay in the channel and let the coast guard trail you into the marina; the shallows stop them.
5. The ending choice does not change the trophy. The gold pops on the last cutscene either way.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
1. Brian Heder calls after the second Keys job. Meet him at the boatyard on the Port Gellhorn docks before 06:00 in-game for the quietest run.
2. Take the Mule van from the customs lot; the keys are in the sun visor. Drive it to the Ambrosia truck stop without touching the highway patrol.
3. If a cruiser picks you up, cut through the salvage yard and kill the lights. The van is slow and will not outrun anything with a radio.
4. Deliver it to the bay behind the truck stop diner. The mission ends as Brian walks away and the trophy pops on the handoff.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.hint: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.guide:
1. Boobie Ike sets the job up at his club in Ambrosia. Bring the Pump Shotgun and at least two sticky bombs.
2. Scout the cartel stash at the grain silos in daylight first. The side gate on the rail line is the only way in without passing a camera.
3. Breach at night: cut the padlock, take the office safe, then hold the silo floor for two waves before the van backs in.
4. Escape north on the dirt road instead of the highway. It ends behind the fairground and drops your wanted level to two stars.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
1. Child's Play starts with a call from Boobie's people about a missing kid at the Ambrosia fairground.
2. Go in without a mask and keep the pistol holstered until the Ferris wheel. The fairground guards only turn hostile if they see a weapon.
3. Follow the dropped candy to the maintenance shed, then chase the kidnapper's Bobcat down the service road.
4. Shoot the Bobcat's rear tyres, not the driver. The mission ends with the kid safe and the trophy on the cutscene.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
1. Headliners is the Real Dimez show at the Vice Beach arena. You are on security for the night: Micro SMG, full armour, and a lot of patience.
2. Walk the balcony route before the set starts. Two of the four attack points are only reachable from the lighting rig stairs.
3. When the first wave comes through the stage door, hold the rail and let the crowd funnel them. Do not chase into the pit.
4. The last phase is the roof. Take the maintenance ladder on the east side and clear the helipad before the chopper lifts.
5. Personal Best is available on this mission's balcony, before the first wave. Take the photo then or not at all.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
1. VCIA Takedown hits the private terminal at Vice City International. The crew meets in the long-stay car park on the south side.
2. Drive through the staff gate in a stolen airport tug, not a civilian car; the tug does not trip the plate readers.
3. The target is in the private lounge. Take the stairs instead of the lift and you skip the two guards on the mezzanine.
4. The escape is a runway chase. Stay on the service road beside runway 27 and leave through the cargo gate before the cruisers close it.
5. Kenton's last mission uses the same airport, so finish This Was No Boat Accident before you start this job.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.hint: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.guide:
1. Operation Savage Glory is Raul's raid on the National Guard depot north of Port Gellhorn. It is the only mission with a Rhino on the lot.
2. Go in with the Carbine Rifle and four sticky bombs: two for the depot gate, one for the armoured transport, one spare.
3. Steal the Rhino while the alarm is already running and drive it out through the fence. Challenging Tank can be finished on the way.
4. The escape runs up the Mount Kalaga switchbacks. The tank is too slow for the last climb, so swap to the Sanchez at the ranger station.
5. The mission ends at the fire lookout and the trophy pops with the chapter card after the debrief.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
1. Open Pause > Stats > Completion. That checklist is the only authority; a trophy counter at 54/55 with 96% means one category is short, not one trophy.
2. Work the categories in order: story and strangers, then hobbies (range, Top Fun, races, bowling, arcade), then crimes (vaults, gangs, shops), then collectibles and exploration.
3. The 52 Leonida areas and the 18 meditations are the two categories players finish at 51/52 and 17/18. The map filter shows both.
4. Do not buy the eight garages before The Cartel Heist; the money is better spent on armour and the Sanchez for the stunt grind.
5. 100% lands with the last checklist line, usually the 250th stunt. The gold and the platinum arrive on the same screen.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
1. The counter is Pause > Stats > Stunts. It counts clean stunt jumps, ramp launches and drift chains; a crash adds nothing.
2. Buy the Sanchez from the Port Gellhorn dealer and keep it at the Downtown garage. Most run-ups are dirt, stairs or a kerb.
3. Start with the jumps under the map filter Stunt Jumps. The airport perimeter and the Mount Kalaga fire roads have the densest clusters.
4. Then farm the fairground ramps in Ambrosia and the container yard at the Port of Vice City: a clean landing on the far side adds one and the ramps reset after a lap.
5. Leave the last forty for the 52-area drive, because half of them sit on the route anyway.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
1. Nine activity types count: golf, tennis, bowling, darts, pool, fishing, hunting, arcade and an airboat tour. One of each, no score needed.
2. Golf at Vice Beach Links, tennis at the Starfish Island courts, bowling at Kolt & Associates in Downtown.
3. Darts at the Rusty Anchor in Port Gellhorn, pool at El Cotorro on Calle Ocho in Little Havana.
4. Fishing with Cal on Key Lento, hunting with Bret in the Grassrivers, any arcade cabinet on the Ocean Beach pier.
5. The airboat tour leaves from the Grassrivers launch at the pumping station. The trophy pops when the tour ends, not when you board.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
1. Three ranges -- Ammu-Nation Vice Beach, Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia -- with 14 challenges each. Gold on all 42 is the silver.
2. Use the range guns: the pistol for the ten-metre drills, the SMG for the rush, the sniper for the fifty-metre line. Your own weapons do not change the score.
3. Gold is a score threshold, not a time. A clean headshot chain beats a fast sloppy run, so reload between strings instead of spraying.
4. The 14th challenge at each range is a timed headshot drill. Aim at the chest and let the recoil walk the second shot up.
5. The counter is Pause > Stats > Hobbies > Shooting Range, and it lists golds per range rather than a single total.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.hint: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.
trophies.guide:
1. Top Fun courses are the drone icons on the map: 14 locations, one win each. They appear after Headliners in Chapter 3.
2. Use the Racing frame. The camera drone is slower and the cargo drone will not fit through the pier gates.
3. Fly each course once without racing to learn the gate order, then restart. The clock only starts at the first gate.
4. Cut inside on the pier and container courses. The gates are wider than they look, and the drone only clips water below the third pylon.
5. The counter is Pause > Stats > Hobbies > Top Fun, listed per location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
1. Twenty different races, not twenty wins in one event. The list is Pause > Stats > Hobbies > Races.
2. Eight street races around Vice City, four boat races out of the marina, four air races from VCIA, four off-road in the Grassrivers.
3. Street races in the Banshee from the showroom job, boat races in the Squalo, air races in the Dodo.
4. Off-road is the hard set: the Sanchez wins the two dirt courses, the trophy truck the two mud courses at the Mud Club.
5. Rubber-banding is strong. Save the boost for the last third and pass on the inside of the final corner, not the first.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Locks when Chapter 3 opens: Cal moves to Port Gellhorn and the challenge is gone from the marina.
trophies.hint: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
1. Cal offers the challenge at his marina on Key Lento once you have finished two of his strand's missions, both of which are short runs out of the same dock.
2. Take the Skiff out at dawn. The bite rate is highest before 07:00, so sleep at the marina until 05:30 and cast at the channel edge, not the flats.
3. You need five keeper snapper before Cal lands four. Use the heavier rod and reel in short pulls; a snapped line costs you the fish and the time.
4. If Cal is ahead, cut the engine and drift. The noise penalty is the only reason he wins, and drifting silences it.
5. Locks at the start of Chapter 3, and there is no replay for a stranger challenge. Keep a manual save from Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
1. The arcade on the Ocean Beach pier has four cabinets. Gator Runner is the shortest at about twenty minutes from start to flag.
2. Gator Runner is a three-lane runner: jump the logs, slide under the branches, and never take the top lane after the bridge.
3. Use the continue at 3,000 points. The cabinet gives one free continue and the ending only needs the final flag, not the score.
4. The trophy pops on the high-score screen, not on the last jump, so let the attract mode run for a second before you walk away.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Locks at the end of Chapter 4: Andy's halfway house closes and the strand leaves the map.
trophies.guide:
1. Andy runs the Second Chances halfway house off Vice Beach. His marker appears after Child's Play in Chapter 2, on the block behind the motel strip.
2. Do his four jobs as they come: three short drives and one fist fight, each advancing the strand by an in-game day.
3. The last mission, Clean Slate, is a drive to the Port Gellhorn clinic with a client in the back. Keep the car under the speed limit or he bolts at the first junction.
4. If he does bolt, do not chase on foot. Block him with the car and he gets back in on his own.
5. Locks at the end of Chapter 4. A manual save from the chapter's first mission is the only way back.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Locks at VCIA Takedown in Chapter 3: the airport shutdown closes Kenton's yard for good.

1. Kenton is the boat mechanic at the Key Lento yard. His strand starts after The Cartel Heist, when the marina reopens.

4. Bring the boat back to the yard without repairing it. Stopping at any dock fails the mission and resets the chase.
5. Do it before VCIA Takedown. After the airport lockdown the strand is gone and there is no replay for it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Locks at the Chapter 3 card: Billy is arrested and his strand leaves the map with him.

2. His first two jobs are deliveries on a Sanchez. The timers are generous, so take the dock road instead of the highway and skip the traffic.
3. The last mission opens as a bar fight at the Rusty Anchor. Use the pool cue, not your gun; a shot fails the mission on the spot.
4. After the fight, ride Billy's bike to the salvage yard and lose the two cruisers in the container lanes. The yard gate is open only at night.
5. Locks at the Chapter 3 card. Billy is off the map after that and the mission cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Eight strands count: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Cal, and the man in the Grassrivers.
2. Each strand is three to five missions and ends with a named final mission. Those finals are the individual bronze trophies.
3. Andy, Kenton and Billy close early. Randy and Tyrone stay open until the finale, and Bret closes with Chapter 4.
4. Bret and Cal are hobbies with a story: Bret's hunting camp west of the Mud Club, Cal's marina on Key Lento.
5. The eighth strand only appears at night in the Grassrivers and is the same event as The Truth Is Out There. If you have that trophy, you have the strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Locks at the end of Chapter 4: Randy's camp is raided and his marker disappears.
trophies.guide:
1. Randy sells guns out of a camp in the Grassrivers. His marker appears during the Savage Glory briefing in Chapter 4, before the raid itself.
2. His jobs are supply runs. Take the Mule up the Mount Kalaga fire road and do not stop at the ranger checkpoint; the ranger only radios ahead if you stop.
3. The last mission is a handoff at the quarry. Park nose-out and keep the engine running before you get out.
4. When the buyers turn, use the Carbine and put the Mule between you and the ridge. The sniper on the crusher is the real threat, not the men on the floor.
5. Locks at the end of Chapter 4, so do the strand before the chapter's last job.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Locks at the final mission: Tyrone leaves Leonida and the strand is gone after the credits.
trophies.guide:
1. Tyrone fences cars from the back of El Cotorro on Calle Ocho. He appears once you own a garage, which makes Little Boxes a prerequisite in practice.
2. Three jobs are car thefts with a delivery window. The Infernus on Starfish Island is the one that pays; the others are filler.
3. The last mission is a swap at the Port of Vice City. Bring the car with a full tank and no wanted level, or the buyer walks.
4. When the swap turns bad, drive into the container yard and switch cars before the chase starts. The buyers follow the plate, not you.
5. Do it before the final mission. There is no Tyrone marker afterwards and no replay.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Eighteen mats in total: six on Vice City beaches, four in the Keys, four in the Grassrivers, two on Mount Kalaga, two in Ambrosia.
2. Hold the meditate prompt for a full thirty seconds. Letting go at twenty-five resets the spot and you start again.
3. The mat on the Ocean Beach pier is only reachable before 09:00, when the morning crowd clears the boards.
4. Mount Kalaga's two mats are at the fire lookout and the ranger station. Take the Sanchez up the fire road, not the main trail.
5. The counter is Pause > Stats > Exploration > Meditations. It reads 17/18 for most players; the Ambrosia mat is tucked behind the grain silo.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Locks at the end of Chapter 4: Bret packs up his camp and the hunt leaves the map.
trophies.hint: Hunt the unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
1. Bret camps west of the Mud Club in the Grassrivers. He appears after the Savage Glory briefing and asks for three trophies before the big one.
2. The three easy hunts are a boar at the pumping station, a gator in the north channel and a buck on the Kalaga fire road. Use the Sniper Rifle and stay downwind.
3. The unique animal is the ghost panther. It only tracks at night, and only after you have finished Bret's first three and slept once.
4. Take the airboat to the marked channel, cut the engine, and follow the paw prints on foot with the bow. A rifle shot spooks it and it will not respawn until the next night.
5. Locks at the end of Chapter 4, so do not leave the panther for the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
1. Cards come in sets of ten and there are twelve sets, most of them tied to a district or a hobby. Three complete sets is the silver.
2. The quickest three: Ambrosia Truckers (truck stop, fairground, silos), Keys Sailors (marina, bridge, two wrecks) and Ocean Beach Lifeguards (pier, beach, three towers).
3. Buy the card pack at any convenience store first; it seeds two cards per set and cuts the search by a fifth.
4. Use Pause > Stats > Collectibles > Cards to see per-set progress. A set shows grey until its tenth card is in, even at nine of ten.
5. The last card of each set tends to sit at a landmark roof, so bring the Sanchez and check the map's collectible filter rather than driving blind.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
1. WAiNK It is the phone app. Install it from the in-game store, then open the camera wheel and hold the WAiNK prompt at any scenic spot.
2. One hundred locations, and the map's WAiNK filter shows only the ones inside your current district. Unlock districts by visiting them once.
3. The density is the trick: Vice Beach alone has 22 spots, Ocean Beach 17, Downtown 15. Do those three and you are two thirds done in an hour.
4. Only one check-in per location counts. The app greys a spot out after it registers, so revisit the grey ones if the counter stalls.
5. The counter is Pause > Stats > Collectibles > WAiNK It and lists registered spots per district.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
1. Challenges are the small timed tests attached to the world: shooting drills, driving records, delivery runs, stunt chains, hunting targets. Fifty of them.
2. Open Pause > Stats > Challenges to see what is left. The list groups by district and shows a tick per challenge, so it doubles as a route planner.
3. Do them by district, not by type. Nine in Ambrosia, eleven around Port Gellhorn, fourteen in Vice City, eight in the Keys, eight in the Grassrivers and Kalaga.
4. Three of the fifty are partner challenges and need both protagonists present. Those are the ones players miss, because the prompt only shows when you are together.
5. The trophy pops on the fiftieth tick, not on the last district.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.hint: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner.
trophies.guide:
1. Both protagonists need to be together, which means free roam after the Chapter 3 opening, not a solo mission.
2. Get to four stars in Vice Beach: rob a store on the strip, then shoot out the two cruisers that answer. Four stars needs a helicopter in the air, so keep firing.
3. Run for the Ocean Beach pier and take the stairs down to the sand; the chopper loses its angle and the boats cannot follow.
4. Break line of sight in the sea caves under the pier and stay still with both characters in cover until the stars fade. The trophy pops the moment the level clears.
5. Do not call Lester-style contacts or use a hideout; those clear the level without credit for escaping together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.hint: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level.
trophies.guide:
1. Pick three shops close together. The Port Gellhorn strip has a liquor store, a pawn shop and a clothes shop within one block, which keeps the wanted level alive between them.
2. Rob shop one with the pistol out at the counter, then walk instead of running to shop two. The level drops if you break contact for more than about twenty seconds.
3. Keep one star burning between shops: knock over a lamp post or fire a shot into the air on the way. That is enough to hold the level without starting a chase.
4. Shop three ends the run. The trophy pops when the third till opens, before the police arrive.
5. Bring a fast car parked facing out on each block, and never use a mask, because the outfit change resets the streak.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide:
1. Discovery means getting in and driving it, not seeing it. Parked, traffic and locked cars all count; a car you only photographed does not.
2. The dealerships are the fastest source: the Vice Beach showroom, the Downtown luxury lot, the Port Gellhorn used lot and the Ambrosia truck stop all have cars that never spawn in traffic.
3. Sit outside the Downtown valet and take each car as it is delivered. Twenty minutes there is worth about fifteen new vehicles.
4. Boats at the marina, aircraft at VCIA and the four police vehicles all count. Steal a cruiser during a two-star chase and a Rhino during Chapter 4.
5. The counter is Pause > Stats > Vehicles, split by class, so you can see which class is short instead of driving at random.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.hint: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
1. Combat Focus is the shoulder-button ability both protagonists share. It drains while active and only refills out of combat.
2. You need five kills inside a single activation, so the target has to be a crowd: a gang operation, a store robbery response or the turf war at the Little Haiti yard.
3. Start the fight from cover, let four or five enemies close in, then activate Focus and take them with the Carbine in short bursts. Headshots extend the window, body shots do not.
4. The Little Havana gang operation is the easiest setup: nine enemies in a courtyard, all in range of one doorway.
5. If Focus empties before the fifth kill, the counter resets. Restart the operation rather than trying to top it up mid-fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.hint: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled way.
trophies.guide:
1. VCIA is the airport east of Vice Beach. An unscheduled departure means taking a plane off a runway without filing a flight plan, which the game treats as a crime.
2. Steal any aircraft from the general aviation apron. The Dodo is easiest; it sits unlocked at hangar 4 during the day.
3. Taxi to runway 27 and take off without answering the tower. The radio prompt appears at the threshold and the wanted level starts the moment you lift.
4. Climb straight out over the water, not over the terminals. Two stars and a helicopter follow you either way, but the sea route leaves the airspace cleanly.
5. The trophy pops as the wheels leave the ground, before the chase starts.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
1. Rhinos are the tanks parked at the National Guard depot north of Port Gellhorn. One sits on the lot during Operation Savage Glory and another spawns there after the chapter.
2. The clean way is inside the mission: steal the Rhino while the alarm is already running, drive it through the fence, and the trophy registers on the escape.
3. Outside the mission, the depot is a restricted area. Go in over the rail line on the north side at night, take the tank from the motor pool and drive out through the main gate.
4. A Rhino cannot outrun anything, so plan the exit: straight down the dirt track to the Grassrivers, where the cruisers cannot follow at speed.
5. The trophy counts either the theft or the destruction of a Rhino, so a sticky bomb on the motor pool tank works too if the drive is going badly.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.hint: Rob a jewelry store without being seen.
trophies.guide:
1. The jewelry store is Kaiser & Co on the Downtown shopping street, between the bank tower and the tram stop.
2. Case the store in daylight: two cameras, one guard at the door, one clerk, and a back door into the service alley.
3. Go in at night with the silenced Combat Pistol and a mask. Take the guard from behind at the display case, then the clerk, without firing near a camera.
4. The cameras can be shot, but a shot that hits glass raises the alarm. Use the fire axe on the fuse box in the alley instead; that kills the cameras silently.
5. Fill the bag from the two front cases only. The safe in the back takes ninety seconds and the patrol car passes the alley on a timer. Leave through the service door and walk, do not run.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
1. Raul unlocks the vault jobs in Chapter 3 and there are five: Vice Beach, Downtown, Little Havana, Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia.
2. Each vault is a two-stage job: a setup to get the codes, then the robbery itself. The setups are easy; the escapes are where runs fail.
3. Do the Vice Beach and Downtown vaults first. They share a garage and the same escape route down the tram tunnel, so you learn the map once.
4. The Little Havana vault has the tightest timer. Bring the Sanchez, not a car, because the escape goes through the market alleys.
5. The trophy pops on the fifth successful escape. Failing an escape does not lose progress, but it does re-arm the whole job.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.hint: Rob an armored truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
1. Armored trucks run a fixed loop on the Overseas Highway and the Port Gellhorn docks. The map filter marks them once you have seen one.
2. Block the truck at a junction rather than ramming it. A head-on hit wrecks the cab and the cargo is lost.
3. Two sticky bombs on the rear doors opens them, then take the bags under fire from the escort car. Kill the driver first so the truck cannot pull away.
4. Lose the two stars in the Grassrivers, not on the highway. The dirt tracks off the pumping station road break the chase in under a minute.
5. The trophy pops when the last bag is collected, before the escape.

3. Dusk is the reliable window: the bar opens at 18:00 and the prompt stays until about 02:00 in-game.

The trophy pops on the last sip, while the camera pulls back over the beach. Judging by the name, the developers meant this one early.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.hint: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in style.
trophies.guide:
1. The showroom is the glass-fronted dealership on the Downtown boulevard. The Infernus on the turntable is the intended tool.
2. Take a car you do not mind losing, reverse it into the plate glass at speed, and then drive the Infernus out through the hole you just made.
3. Better: bring the Rhino. One nudge from the tank puts the whole front wall through and the showroom staff run instead of reaching for a gun.
4. If the alarm goes off, drive into the tram tunnel under the boulevard and wait it out. Two stars, gone in forty seconds.
5. The trophy pops when the glass breaks, so a slow reverse works too; you do not have to take a car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.hint: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley.
trophies.guide:
1. Kolt & Associates is on the Downtown block behind the bank tower, with a bowling pin sign over the door.
2. Walk in, rent a lane at the counter and play a full ten-frame game. The trophy needs a finished game, not a good score.
3. Aim with a short backswing and let the ball go on the third step. The lane oil is light, so the ball hooks late and a straight line down the second arrow holds.
4. Bring a partner if you want the two-player frame; it counts the same and the animations are worth seeing once.
5. The trophy pops when the tenth frame scores, before you leave the lane.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Locks at the end of Chapter 3: the balcony is closed after Headliners and the mission replay does not re-arm the prompt.
trophies.hint: A partnership moment with mass appeal.
trophies.guide:
1. This is the Headliners balcony moment. During the mission, before the first wave comes through the stage door, walk out to the balcony rail with both protagonists.
2. The prompt appears on the rail, aimed at the crowd below. Take the photo with the phone camera; the framing wants the stage lights and both of you in shot.
3. Do it before you touch the lighting rig stairs. Once the attack starts, the balcony is out of bounds and the prompt never returns.
4. The mission replay does not re-arm it, so if you miss it, load a manual save from before Headliners. That is the only recovery.
5. Locks with the Chapter 3 card. The trophy itself is the photograph, so it pops on the shutter.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.hint: Make choices (PSN tracks a count to 500).
trophies.guide:
1. Choices are the dialogue prompts and the planning boards. Every story job offers at least two: who drives, who talks, whether to take the quiet route.
2. They also come from partner conversations in the car and at the safehouse, and from the stranger jobs where you can side with one character or the other.
3. Fifty choices is the trophy threshold and it arrives on its own if you are playing normally. Replay missions picking the other option to speed it up.
4. The tally is in Pause > Stats > General > Choices. The system-side statistic keeps counting to 500 for its own records long after the trophy has fired.
5. There is no correct answer and no penalty for picking badly. The story bends around either option and nothing becomes missable because of a choice.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide:
1. The trophy wants a second attempt, not a first. Any mission, race, challenge or activity with a retry prompt counts.
2. The cleanest way: run the Skiff into the rocks on the way back from the buoy line in Gone Fishing, or fail a street race on the Vice Beach circuit.
3. When the mission fails screen comes up, choose Retry instead of quitting to free roam. That is what registers the second attempt.
4. Win, finish or survive the retry. The trophy pops on the completion screen with a small note that the second time was the charm.
5. Loading a manual save does not count as a retry. It has to be the in-game retry from the failure screen.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: Locks at the end of Chapter 4: the Grassrivers light only appears on a clear night during that chapter.
trophies.guide:
1. Drive the pumping station road in the Grassrivers on a clear night, after Bret has been introduced in Chapter 4. The event is a light over the marsh that follows the car.
2. Stop the car and get out when the radio starts cutting out. Walk toward the light; it moves away and the ground goes quiet.
3. Do not chase it into the water. Follow it to the third marker post, then turn around. The camera takes over and the scene plays out.
4. Clear weather is required. If it is raining in-game, sleep at the Mud Club until morning and come back the next night.
5. Locks at the end of Chapter 4. It is also the eighth stranger strand, so finishing it feeds Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.hint: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
1. A melee drive-by is a swing from a moving vehicle: hold the melee button while driving and the character leans out with the bat.
2. Take any car to the Port Gellhorn docks road, where the sidewalk is wide and the traffic is slow, and drive alongside a pedestrian.
3. Swing as you pass. The hit only registers if the car is still moving, so keep a steady speed rather than stopping next to them.
4. The trophy pops on the knock-down. You do not need a kill, and the docks crowd is thin enough that a wanted level is easy to shake.
5. Doing it on the Ocean Beach promenade works too, but the crowds there make the escape more annoying than it is worth.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
1. Marked bills come out of the five bank vaults, the armored trucks and the bigger gang operations. They are a separate currency from cash and cannot be spent in shops.
2. Laundering happens through contacts: the Downtown Syndicate fence, the Port Gellhorn pawn broker and the Little Havana money changer. Each takes a cut and returns clean cash.
3. The contacts cap how much they will clean per in-game day, so the real constraint is time, not skill. Sleep at the safehouse to roll the day over rather than driving around waiting.
4. Five vaults plus a couple of armored trucks clears $250,000 with room to spare. Do not bother with gang operations for this one; they pay poorly in marked bills.
5. The counter is Pause > Stats > Crimes > Marked bills laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
1. Every shop purchase counts: clothes, weapons at Ammu-Nation, car mods, food, tattoos, haircuts, the card packs and the property deposits at the garages.
2. One hundred thousand is not much once you have a vault behind you, but it is a lot in Chapter 2. Sell a stolen car at the Port Gellhorn lot first.
3. The fastest legitimate sink is car mods: buy a Banshee, then spend on brakes, engine, transmission and paint at the Vice Beach mod shop. That is about $40,000 in five minutes.
4. Weapons and armour count too. Stocking both safehouses with Carbine ammo and body armour is another $20,000 you will actually use.
5. The counter is Pause > Stats > General > Money spent in shops, and it counts gross spend, not net.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide:
1. Eight garage properties: two in Vice City (Downtown and Vice Beach), two in Ambrosia, one in Port Gellhorn, one in the Keys, one in Little Havana and one at the Grassrivers pumping station.
2. Buy them from the phone property app once The Cartel Heist has introduced the system. The interiors come with a car slot, a weapon locker and a free repair.
3. Prices total about $600,000. The five bank vaults cover most of it; the armored trucks and the nine gang operations cover the rest.
4. Buy the cheap three first (Keys, Port Gellhorn, Grassrivers) to unlock the car slots, then the Vice City pair once the vault money lands.
5. The trophy pops on the eighth purchase, and every garage stays yours for the rest of the game, so it also feeds Whip It Good and Little Boxes-related storage.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.hint: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
1. Scooter Bros is the delivery app on the phone. Open it, register as a rider, and the app starts tracking the vehicles you own.
2. Registration means parking the car at a Scooter Bros depot and confirming it in the app. Ten different vehicles, not ten trips in one car.
3. The Keys depots are the easiest: the marina lot, the bridge lay-by and the Port Gellhorn docks are a short drive apart and the traffic there is slow enough to steal from.
4. Anything counts, including a stolen Mule van, a Sanchez and a boat if the depot has a slip. Duplicates do not, so keep a list in the app.
5. The trophy pops on the tenth confirmation. The app shows nine of ten as a full row with one empty slot, which is how most players notice they registered a duplicate.
